paragraphs.zh: 所述磷配体或其盐优选为1,3-(双二苯基膦)丙烷、1,4-双(二苯基膦)丁烷或者双[(4-N,N-二甲氨基)苯基]二叔丁基膦。
paragraphs.en: The phosphine ligand or a salt thereof is preferably 1,3-(bis(diphenylphosphino))propane, 1,4-bis(diphenylphosphino)butane, or bis[(4-N,N-dimethylamino)phenyl]di-tert-butylphosphine.
paragraphs.notes: Continuation of the claim that begins on the previous page (claim 3); this page carries no claim tag for it. The first ligand is printed as 1,3-(双二苯基膦)丙烷, with the parenthesis placed around the whole 双二苯基膦 rather than as 1,3-双(二苯基膦)丙烷 used for the C4 homologue on the same line; transcribed as printed.

paragraphs.zh: 根据权利要求3所述的方法，其中反应溶剂是选自甲苯、1,4-二氧六环、乙二醇二甲醚、乙二醇二乙醚、二甲基亚砜(DMSO)、四氢呋喃(THF)、N,N-二甲基甲酰胺(DMF)中的一种或两种以上。
paragraphs.en: The process according to claim 3, wherein the reaction solvent is one or two or more selected from toluene, 1,4-dioxane, ethylene glycol dimethyl ether, ethylene glycol diethyl ether, dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO), tetrahydrofuran (THF), and N,N-dimethylformamide (DMF).

paragraphs.notes: As printed, claim 6 depends on claim 4, but steps (i) to (iv) are introduced in claim 5, not claim 4. Transcribed as printed, not corrected.

drawings.notes: Four separate one-arrow transformations stacked vertically, labelled (i), (ii), (iii) and (iv) at the right of each row; (iv) is followed by a full-width period. No reagents or conditions are written on any of the four arrows. The dashed appearance of arrows (iii) and (iv) may be scan degradation of a solid arrow rather than a deliberate dashed arrow; arrows (i) and (ii) on the same page are clearly solid, which is why the difference is recorded rather than normalised.

Labelled (i') at the right. Same transformation as step (i) above, now with the reagent Br2 written above the arrow. This is the last content on the page; the lower half of the page is blank, so the scheme for steps (ii') to (iv') presumably continues on the next page.

discrepancies.what: Steps (i) to (iv) are drawn with bare arrows carrying no reagents, while the prose of claim 5 promises the steps 'shown below' without naming any reagent either; the reagent Br2 appears only in the redrawn step (i') under claim 6.
discrepancies.drawing_says: arrows in (i)-(iv) are unlabelled; the arrow in (i') carries Br2 above it
discrepancies.text_says: claim 5 text names no reagents; claim 6 text says the steps are 'each independently the following steps' and then defers entirely to the drawing

discrepancies.what: Claim 6 as printed depends on claim 4, but the steps (i) to (iv) it refers to are introduced in claim 5.
